purpose: Public legal discovery index for Russia–Ukraine peace and regeneration analysis. NOT an exhaustive legislation library.
caveats: Directory entries are navigation aids, not legal opinions or confirmations of current force.
EU law and domestic law may apply jointly; ECHR, IHL and treaty systems must be distinguished.
Legislation can be amended daily; always recheck the full instrument, implementation measures and current official status.
Publisher links do not prove applicability, sanctions licenses, institution involvement or a conflict party agreement.
Country metadata and summaries are offline; the actual law text is accessible only through the external website unless independently downloaded with permission.
Countries without independently confirmed primary-source portals are not included; regional, local, sanctions and treaty documentation remains selective rather than exhaustive.

reviewQuestions: Identify the exact paragraph, enactment date, amendments and legal effect.
Identify actors and territory over which the law applies.
Distinguish enacted binding law from policy, draft, treaty signature and judgment.
Verify treaty ratification, reservations and jurisdiction at the relevant date.
Review national implementing measures, exceptions, permits and sanctions designations.
Do not rely on a translated summary where an authoritative text is required.
Document provenance, access date, review owner and evidence against the proposed intervention.
